name.full: Finance Foundation for Cowork (Independent community project)

description.short: Shared finance data, tie-out, model checks, FX and commentary skills.
description.full: Finance Foundation for Cowork: an independent community project maintained by a Microsoft employee. Not an official Microsoft product or resource, and not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft. A Finance skill set for Copilot Cowork, built for all finance teams. Every skill prepares and recommends but never posts, releases, approves, files or sends without an explicit instruction; every figure is labelled and traced to its source; thresholds come from the user or the shared Finance Profile. Skills (7): Set up finance profile; Ingest finance data; Tie out numbers; Audit spreadsheet model; Translate currency; Digest finance workstreams; Write executive commentary. Works alongside the other Finance for Cowork plugins; install Finance Foundation for Cowork for the shared Finance Profile.
